claims_excluded: hard real-time bound beyond frozen finite windows

decision.diagnostic_pass: instrumentation is proven loaded by an input-free subprocess and the live run records exact producer retirement method entry/return timestamps or a bounded trace showing which call remains open at callback release.
decision.stop: One fixture, one dispatch, at most one cancel; never replay or retry. Any setup mismatch stops before input.
decision.strict_action_outcome: The R29 strict blocked-release gate is unchanged: 21 or more same-call polls during a full 1250 ms post-cancel hold must show recovered/release-confirmed and the separate same-generation Q-up readback must be valid before callback return; otherwise preserve FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN.

environment.host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
environment.low_level_hooks_timeout_registry: HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\LowLevelHooksTimeout absent at R29 preflight; read only

host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
hypothesis: With the R31 Unicode compensation path removed, the recovery helper has one remaining Q-up SendInput. The trace tests whether that exact native call and public release receipt complete while the low-level Q-down callback remains blocked.

instrumentation.mode: Test-only wrappers around helper exchange, helper process, _recover, release_all and each _send. Record VK, scan code, key-up flags and Q-up entry/return/exception, preserving original return values.

nonclaims: hard real-time bound beyond frozen finite windows
resource_boundary: One user-authorized local Windows PC, one owned fixture/window and hook; one dispatch, one cancellation, one 1250 ms callback hold. No text operation, retry, replay, external window, or registry mutation. WSLc S01 is a separate sibling packet.
retry_policy: Input-free hash/predecessor/registry preflight then one fresh fixture, one dispatch, and at most one cancel after hook entry and same-call running status; no input retry, replay, or rerun. Preserve any failure.

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe

trial.cancel: one public interface_cancel for the exact dispatch call_id; no second cancel
trial.effect_order: fixture click, sentinel text and CTRL+S save happen before the Q-down cancellation point; task effect is read independently after the recovery flow.

native_stimulus.hook: one WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook in the probe process
native_stimulus.release: Hold only the first injected Q-down callback for 1250ms after cancel response. This attempt deliberately has no text operation, so recovery has no Unicode compensation obligation; trace the exact VK_Q key-up SendInput interval. Release at the frozen hold end or callback 1500ms self-deadline.

trial.pre_cancel_readback: After hook entry, interface_results must show action status running before one interface_cancel call.
trial.target: one fresh owned fixture process/window; exact call_id obtained from the public zero-wait pending-or-terminal dispatch response
